_meta.description: Task 1.1 (REQ-VBTW-004): a posted ledger line carries the VAT tariff it was booked at, the VAT return box of that tariff (the tariff's `section`) and whether its amount is the base or the VAT, stamped when it is posted. VAT declarations and VAT lines of a prepared return carry the box they belong to. None of the fields is required: lines posted before this change have none until the backfill (task 1.3) stamps them. Task 5.1 (REQ-TVRB-003): a VAT fiscal unity (VatFiscalUnity) of a representative administration and its members; a VAT line names the administration whose ledger line it was taken from, and a unity's return carries the unity, its VAT number and a subtotal per administration. Task 4.1 (REQ-TVRB-002): a VAT correction found by checking a broken fiscal year carries that fiscal year, its name and the year's correction total, to which the EUR 1,000 threshold then applies.

vatTariffCode.description: The VatTariff code this line was booked at (for example high, low, reverse-charge). Set when the line is posted from a document line that has a tariff.
vatTariffCode.title: VAT tariff

vatReturnBox.description: The box of the VAT return this line counts in: the tariff's section for sales and reverse-charged purchases, 5b for input VAT. Empty for a line that is in no box, such as the base of an ordinary purchase.
vatReturnBox.title: VAT return box

vatAmountKind.description: Whether this line's amount is the base the VAT is charged on (the revenue or cost line) or the VAT itself (the line on the output or input VAT account).
vatAmountKind.title: VAT amount kind

returnBox.description: The VAT return box this declaration totals.
returnBox.title: Return box

returnBox.description: The VAT return box of the ledger line this VAT line was taken from.
returnBox.title: Return box

sourceAdministrationId.description: The administration whose ledger line this VAT line was taken from. For a VAT fiscal unity's return this is the representative or a member; otherwise the return's own administration.
sourceAdministrationId.title: Source administration

fiscalUnityId.description: The VAT fiscal unity this return is filed for, when the administration is its representative in the period.
fiscalUnityId.title: VAT fiscal unity

vatNumber.description: The VAT number the return is filed under: the unity's number for a fiscal unity's return.
vatNumber.title: VAT number

memberSubtotals.description: For a VAT fiscal unity's return, the totals per administration, the representative first.
memberSubtotals.title: Subtotals per administration

VatFiscalUnity.title: VAT fiscal unity
VatFiscalUnity.description: A fiscal unity for VAT (fiscale eenheid omzetbelasting, art. 7 lid 4 Wet OB 1968): a representative administration and its member administrations that file one VAT return under the unity's own VAT number while the unity runs. Preparing a return for the representative in a period the unity covers reads the posted lines of every member; preparing one for a member in such a period is refused and names the unity. Separate from the corporate income tax unity (FiscaleEenheid), which rests on other conditions and has another number.

name.description: The name of the unity as the returns and refusals show it.
name.title: Name

administrationId.description: The representative administration, which files the return for the unity.
administrationId.title: Representative administration

memberAdministrationIds.description: The member administrations whose posted lines the unity's return includes.
memberAdministrationIds.title: Member administrations

vatNumber.description: The VAT number the Belastingdienst gave the unity.
vatNumber.title: VAT number

startDate.description: The first day the unity files as one.
startDate.title: Start date

endDate.description: The last day of the unity, empty while it runs.
endDate.title: End date

notes.description: Free notes, such as the Belastingdienst decision.
notes.title: Notes

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a VAT fiscal unity is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

fiscalYearId.description: The fiscal year this correction was found in, when the administration's fiscal year is not the calendar year.
fiscalYearId.title: Fiscal year

fiscalYearLabel.description: The name of that fiscal year, such as 2025/2026; the corrections page groups by it.
fiscalYearLabel.title: Fiscal year

fiscalYearCorrectionTotal.description: The total of the corrections of that fiscal year when it was checked. The EUR 1,000 threshold for a separate supplementary return applies to this total.
fiscalYearCorrectionTotal.title: Fiscal year correction total
